🌅 Market News Digest
[Oct 29-30, 2026 EST]

🔥 Top Stories
• Binance hacked for ~$6.3B — largest crypto heist on record; exchange says user funds safe, covers losses, withdrawals to resume in ~45-48h, ~$3B frozen
• Middle East risk jumps — tanker fire/off Oman, Houthi drone claims, Iran talks continue while Trump says war could end “soon”; crude bounced on escalation fears
• BOJ holds rates at 1.25% — 8-1 vote with Takata dissent; Ueda signals more hikes possible as inflation/Wage trends stay near target
• Global risk-off hits equities — US futures, Nikkei, KOSPI and Taiwan all sold off on tech weakness and macro anxiety; Treasuries rallied, yields fell

📊 Markets & Macro
• US futures sink after weak Amazon/Intel earnings; 2Y Treasury yield at 7-week low as rate-hike odds ease
• Japan data mixed-to-firm — Tokyo CPI 2.8%, unemployment 2.4%, industrial output beats; yen firmer after BOJ
• Europe inflation hotter — France/Italy/Spain prints run above forecasts; eurozone GDP +0.4% q/q, unemployment 6.5%
• China liquidity support — PBOC sets yuan midpoint strongest since 2023 and injects 1T yuan overnight
• Germany GDP edges up while import prices surge; French GDP/contracts weak, keeping ECB hawkish

⛽ Oil & Energy
• Crude volatile on Iran/Ukraine — Brent/WTI bounced as peace hopes faded; Ukraine pause on Russian refineries may support supply, but Hormuz incident adds risk
• BP, Chevron, Exxon beat estimates — strong Q3 cash flow/earnings and higher dividends/capex discipline
• EU carbon price tops €90/ton — adds upside pressure to European energy/inflation costs

🪙 Crypto & DeFi
• Bitcoin drops below $78k and ETH hits 2-month low after Binance shock; over $1.3B leveraged longs liquidated
• Stablecoin issuers froze funds — Tether/Circle action helped lock down billions of stolen assets
• Coinbase/industry response — exchanges and law enforcement coordinating; Binance says it reserved $6.34B to cover incident
• COIN target cuts — several brokers slash price targets on exchange-risk and crypto volatility

🏛️ Regulatory & Policy
• UK CMA probes Meta commercial terms; Meta/TikTok/X lose Ofcom challenge over data requests
• Japan asks US tech giants for broader model access for vulnerability checks
• EU eyes new e-commerce fees that could raise ~€5.9B/year from 2028
• PBOC / BOJ policy signals — China keeps easy liquidity; BOJ still sees rates rising over time

🏢 Corporate
• Nvidia-linked AI financing talks — reported credit support for Anthropic/Nscale mega-deals underscores AI capex race
• Strong pharma/consumer earnings — AstraZeneca, AbbVie, Sanofi, Colgate all topped estimates
• SoftBank slides 5.7% amid broader tech selloff; Kioxia/NAND pricing strength stands out
• Tesco to sell Czech/Slovakia ops; Virgin Media O2 nears BT broadband network deal; Apple removed from BofA US 1 list
